agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
January 26, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR BLACK HISTORY MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim February 2021 as Black History Month in the City of La Mirada.
5.1 Proclamation for Black History Month
5.2
RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEE FOR YEARS OF SERVICE - It is recommended the City Council recognize Tammie Acosta for her years of service and present her with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
5.2 Recognition of Employee for Years of Service
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of January 12, 2021 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of January 12, 2021.
7.1 Minutes of 1-12-21 SS
7.1 Minutes of 1-12-21 CC
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated January 26, 2021 in the total amount of $1,344,071.95.
7.2 Warrant Register
7.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING NOVEMBER 2020 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending November 2020.
7.3 Monthly Treasurer Report
7.4
COMPREHENSIVE ANNUAL FINANCIAL REPORT (CAFR) AND RELATED DOCUMENTS FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDED JUNE 30, 2020 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report and related documents for the Fiscal Year ended June 30, 2020.
7.4 Report on CAFR
7.4 CAFR Documents B-D
CAFR
7.5
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENTS WITH BLODGETT BAYLOSIS ENVIRONMENTAL PLANNING FOR THE PREPARATION OF A COMPREHENSIVE INITIAL STUDY AND MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION ENVIRONMENTAL ASSESSMENT FOR THE EXPANSION OF THE SHASTA BEVERAGES FACILITY LOCATED AT 14405 ARTESIA BOULEVARD - It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute a Professional Services Agreement with Blodgett Baylosis Environmental Planning for the preparation of a comprehensive Initial Study and Mitigated Negative Declaration Environmental Assessment in an amount not to exceed $36,350 and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work that may be required to complete the environmental assessment up to 15 percent of the authorized proposal amount.
7.5 Agreement with Blodgett Baylosis Environmental Planning
7.6
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE A VEHICLE - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of one Ford Escape Hybrid Titanium in the amount of $33,085.43 from Huntington Beach Ford.
7.6 Authorization to Purchase a Vehicle
8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM (CDBG) PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 PROJECTS - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law; approve the proposed Fiscal Year 2021-22 Community Development Block Grant projects as presented; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contracts, make any changes if needed and execute amendments with the Los Angeles County Development Authority on behalf of the City.
8.1 CDBG Proposed FY 2021-22 Projects
